name: Dark Chocolate Rye Cookies

recipeInstructions.text: Melt chocolate and butter together over a bain-marie. Set aside to cool slightly.
Whisk eggs, sugar, and vanilla until thick and pale, about 3 minutes.
Fold the warm chocolate mixture into the eggs.
Sift over rye flour and baking powder, fold gently until just combined.
Chill the batter for 30 minutes — this is non-negotiable for the crackled top.
Scoop walnut-sized portions onto lined trays, leaving room to spread.
Bake at 180°C / 355°F for 11–12 minutes. Sprinkle with flaky salt while warm.

description: Deeply chocolatey, slightly malty cookies with crackled tops and a chewy centre. Rye flour does the heavy lifting.
